background_estimates.method: Symmetric vector capsule fitted from resting-track outer contours; active-frame color measured from exposed track. Distant unoccluded RGB is copied; hidden/halo-adjacent input is modeled.
background_estimates.limits: Track symmetry, hidden color uniformity and separation from the thumb shadow are assumptions. Conditional rendering scores are not proof of complete photographic background recovery or proprietary Apple optics.

resting_track_fits.method: Outer half-contrast contour of the resting track; fit symmetric capsule, four pose/size parameters.
